How to write an honest Black Friday email with AI (before and after)

"Huge savings on everything! Limited time only!" tells people nothing: not what they get, not until when, not why to believe it.

Copy this:

"Rewrite this Black Friday email. Use only these facts: offer [WHAT THEY GET], for [WHO], dates [START–END], limits [ANY]. No fake urgency, no 'biggest ever', no prices or savings I didn't give you. Subject under 45 characters, email under 90 words. Email: [PASTE]"

I tried it with an invented candle studio whose offer is free gift wrap and a handwritten note. The rewrite named the offer, the dates, who it's for and the delivery cut-off, with a calm subject line.

You don't need a discount to take part. A real, useful extra and a clear deadline is an offer. Just make sure every fact in the email is true for your business.
